bcca2d.title: Django DEBUG pages expose settings and source paths
bcca2d.content: Unauthenticated GET requests to `https://alfikr.id/data/berita/x/`, `/data/json/berita/`, `/berita/tags/x/1/`, `/filter/terpopuler/berita/`, `/tambah/berita/`, and `/save-token/` return HTTP 500 Django technical pages. Pages show `DEBUG = True`, full tracebacks, source locations such as `/home/web2/berita/views.py` and `/home/web2/alfikr_env/lib/python3.12/site-packages/...`, URLconf `Alfikr.urls`, installed applications, request metadata, and database configuration. `SECRET_KEY` is masked as `********************`; no raw secret observed. Root and generic invalid paths return a DEBUG 404 page with complete URL pattern inventory. Admin/debug/metrics/swagger candidate paths tested returned generic 404s.

968e14.title: Public endpoint inventory from bounded crawl
968e14.content: Enumerated https://alfikr.id/ public surface. Core HTML: GET / (homepage, 48 article data-id cards), /redaksi/ (editorial page), /redaksi/login/ (POST login form fields csrfmiddlewaretoken,email,password), /tentang/kami/ (page currently says Page Not Found content), /sop/tulisan/ (submission criteria), /create/tulisan/kontributor/ (POST multipart form fields csrfmiddlewaretoken,foto,nama,no_hp,email,mediaSosial,alamat,fileTulisan,deskripsiDiri), /detail/berita/ctg/{slug}/ (category pages: news, opini, kolom, indepth, feature, pelita-hati, rana, santri, sastra; some invalid slugs redirect to /), /detail/berita/sub/ctg/{subid}/news/all/{page}/ (observed subids 11,2,3; invalid 999 gives Django 500), /data/detail/berita/{title-slug}/{id}/ (article detail; observed IDs 1829,1825,1817,1809,1808 etc.), /cari/berita/ (POST search form fields cari,tahun,bulan), /cari/berita/terbaru/json/ (GET 200 JSON public latest articles), /cari/berita/json/ (POST JSON search; GET gives CSRF 403), /filter/terpopuler/berita/?filter={minggu|bulan|tahun} (GET currently Django 500 TypeError), /save-token/ (POST application/json {token}; GET currently Django 500 JSONDecodeError), /firebase-messaging-sw.js (public JS service worker, Firebase config/project IDs and VAPID key), /media/... assets, /static/... assets. Headers: nginx/1.14.2, Django 5.2.8 debug pages observed on malformed/unsupported requests, X-Frame-Options DENY, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Referrer-Policy same-origin, HSTS, csrftoken SameSite=Lax and sessionid HttpOnly SameSite=Lax. No /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, /admin/, /api/, /graphql, /swagger/, /openapi.json found (404 or redirects). Dynamic JS uses detail route and category route; homepage also fetches /filter/terpopuler/berita/?filter=...; search JS fetches latest JSON then POST search JSON. Katana encountered debug-linked filesystem paths in crawl (e.g. /usr/local/lib/python3.12/json/__init__.py, /home/web2/berita/views.py, Django handler paths) due DEBUG error pages; likely important to debug agent.

02b55f.title: Unauthenticated Django DEBUG pages validated
02b55f.content: GET https://alfikr.id/save-token/ with no cookies/body returns 500 JSONDecodeError and ~64KB HTML. Page includes `Django Version: 5.2.8`, Python 3.12.10, traceback/source code `/home/web2/berita/views.py` line 132, executable `/home/web2/alfikr_env/bin/python3.12`, BASE_DIR `/home/web2`, `DEBUG True`, DB engine mysql host localhost DB name `alfikr_news_v2` user `alfikrco`, SMTP user `alfikrdotco@gmail.com`, MEDIA_ROOT `/home/web2/media`, STATIC paths, installed apps and middleware, request META. Secret/password values are rendered `********************`. GET `/data/json/berita/` returns 500 AttributeError at views.py:1341 and same settings panel. Random unknown GET gives DEBUG 404 route inventory. POST `/save-token/` blocked by CSRF 403. Coverage IDs fcdce0,50efb6,f09f3b.

8d2cad.title: Alfikr black-box surface inventory
8d2cad.content:
Recon on https://alfikr.id (2026-09-04): DNS A 36.92.8.230, NS rinjani.cloudhost.id/bromo.cloudhost.id, MX mx.idcloudhost.com; CT/subfinder yielded apex only (no subdomains). Nmap top100: TCP 80,443,2000 open; 80 serves static nginx 2018 page, HTTPS app Server nginx/1.14.2. HTTPS is Django with DEBUG=True: any invalid path (e.g. /robots.txt) returns full Django 404 showing Alfikr.urls route list, framework source paths (`/home/web2/...`, `/usr/local/lib/python3.12/...`) and explicit debug message. Headers include duplicate X-Frame-Options and X-Content-Type-Options, HSTS, SameSite=Lax csrftoken/sessionid.

Observed public pages: /, /tentang/kami/, /redaksi/, /redaksi/login/, /cari/berita/, /sop/tulisan/, /create/tulisan/kontributor/ (public multipart form), /firebase-messaging-sw.js (Firebase config apiKey/projectId), /save-token/ (GET gives 500 debug). Public JSON/data: /cari/berita/terbaru/json/ (200, article records), /data/json/berita/lain/ (200), /values/ctg/berita/ (200 category list), /values/ctg/sub/berita/<id>/ (200), /dashboard/terpopuler/berita/ (200 stats), /dashboard/monitoring/penulis/ (200 stats), /dashboard/monitoring/pengunjung/ (200 stats), /penulis/data/json/kontributor/ (200, returns contributor PII incl id/name/phone/email/address, file paths/status) without auth. /data/json/berita/ and /cari/berita/json/ and /save-token/ GET return 500 debug.

Debug route list extracted: admin/alfikr/; redaksi/; majalah/; data/berita/<str:role>/; data/berita/<str:role>/publish/; data/json/berita/; data/json/berita/publish/; data/detail/berita/<str:title>/<int:id>/; detail/berita/ctg/<str:ctg>/; detail/berita/sub/ctg/<int:id>/<str:ctg>/all/<int:cat_id>/; data/json/berita/lain/; berita/tags/<str:tag>/<int:id>/; loading/berita/tags/<str:tag>/; cari/berita/; cari/berita/terbaru/json/; cari/berita/json/; hapus/berita/json/; tambah/berita/; values/ctg/berita/; values/ctg/sub/berita/<int:id>/; edit/berita/<str:title>/<int:id>/; edit/berita/publish/; edit/berita/takedown/; berita/utama/redaksi/; berita/utama/redaksi/<int:id>/; filter/terpopuler/berita/; dashboard/terpopuler/berita/; dashboard/monitoring/penulis/; dashboard/monitoring/pengunjung/; setting/tentang/kami/; tentang/kami/; category/; json/category/; edit/category/<int:id>/; create/category/; hapus/category/; edit/category/simpan/; sub/category/; data/json/sub/category/; create/sub/category/; hapus/sub/category/; edit/sub/category/<int:id>/; edit/sub/data/category/; penulis/kontributor/; penulis/data/json/kontributor/; create/tulisan/kontributor/; hapus/tulisan/kontributor/; detail/tulisan/kontributor/<int:id>/; update/tulisan/kontributor/<int:id>/<str:status>/; tulisan/check-download/<int:pk>/; tulisan/download/<int:pk>/; sop/tulisan/setting/; sop/tulisan/; save-token/; firebase-messaging-sw.js; media/cdn/content/; ^static/<path>; ^media/<path>.

Crawl also surfaced malformed source file links due DEBUG: /home/web2/berita/views.py, /usr/local/lib/python3.12/json/__init__.py, Django handlers paths. WAFW00F: no WAF detected. HTTP (port80) does not redirect to HTTPS (stale nginx page). Common /static/ and /media/ dirs 403; /.env/swagger/openapi/api/admin return debug 404.

24b9a8.title: Additional sitemap-only routes
24b9a8.content: Caido sitemap (367 entries, many test probes) exposed first-party route families beyond crawl: /admin/alfikr/login/ (200 Django admin login), /admin/alfikr/ (302 login), /redaksi/dashboard/ (500 unauth debug), /data/berita/{slug}/ (500 in tested x/redaksi), /data/berita/{slug}/publish/ (302), /data/json/berita/ (500), /data/json/berita/publish/ (OPTIONS 403), /data/json/berita/lain/ (OPTIONS 200), /data/detail/berita/{slug}/{id}/ (200 valid, 302 missing), /detail/berita/ctg/{slug}/ (200 valid, 302 invalid), /berita/tags/{tag}/{page}/ (500 invalid tags), /loading/berita/tags/{tag}/ (200/500), /hapus/berita/json/ (500), /tambah/berita/ (500), /edit/berita/{slug}/{id}/ (302), /edit/berita/publish/ and /edit/berita/takedown/ (405), /berita/utama/redaksi/ (405), /berita/utama/redaksi/{id}/ (403), /values/ctg/berita/ and /values/ctg/sub/berita/{id}/ (OPTIONS 200), /dashboard/terpopuler/berita/, /dashboard/monitoring/penulis/, /dashboard/monitoring/pengunjung/ (OPTIONS 200), /setting/tentang/kami/ (302), category CRUD paths (/category/, /json/category/, /edit/category/{id}/, /create/category/, /sub/category/, /data/json/sub/category/, /create/sub/category/, /edit/sub/category/{id}/), contributor paths (/penulis/kontributor/, /penulis/data/json/kontributor/, /detail/tulisan/kontributor/{id}/), /sop/tulisan/setting/ (200). Most admin/editorial paths redirect or error unauthenticated; no credentials tested.

3dc082.title: Confirmed contributor PII and document exposure
3dc082.content: Unauthenticated GET https://alfikr.id/penulis/data/json/kontributor/ returns HTTP 200 JSON (1169 bytes) with 3 records including id, full name, phone, email, social handle, physical address, timestamps, draft/review status, editor name, and uploaded file path. No auth/cookie required; HEAD and OPTIONS also return same dataset; POST is CSRF-blocked 403. Each file path is directly downloadable unauthenticated under /media/fileTulisan/... (e.g. Opini_Banjir_Jember.docx 200, 14,626 bytes, public cache max-age 604800). DOCX content includes contributor identity and unpublished opinion. This is confirmed cross-user PII plus private document disclosure.

102a2b.title: Auth and method controls tested for contributor endpoint
102a2b.content: GET contributor JSON remains identical (HTTP 200, 1169 bytes, same SHA-256) with no headers, invalid Authorization bearer, invalid session cookie, X-Requested-With, or Accept:text/html. Query parameters page/limit/id/status do not alter response. POST without CSRF returns 403, while OPTIONS and HEAD are 200 and expose metadata/body semantics. This confirms disclosure is unauthenticated GET read path, not a cache/auth-header artifact.

dc27d1.title: Contributor fields accept XSS payload
dc27d1.content: POST /create/tulisan/kontributor/ with valid 1x1 JPEG + minimal PDF and CSRF accepted `<svg/onload=alert(1)>` in `nama`, `mediaSosial`, and `alamat`; response JSON status true. `/penulis/data/json/kontributor/` unauthenticated then returned id 69 with these fields verbatim in JSON. Stored XSS execution/rendering still needs validation; spawned Stored XSS Validator (6ed2a1bc).

21a779.title: Contributor upload accepts arbitrary extension and public inline serving
21a779.content: Unauthenticated POST /create/tulisan/kontributor/ accepts fileTulisan with arbitrary extensions/content despite client accept=.pdf,.doc,.docx and server form returning status true. Valid JPEG required for foto. Uploaded file is directly available at /media/fileTulisan/<basename> without auth. Tested unique HTML, SVG, JS files; GET returned 200 with attacker-controlled body and MIME (text/html, image/svg+xml, application/javascript), no Content-Disposition and no X-Content-Type-Options. Browser opened uploaded HTML and executed script (document.title changed to marker). Filename '../traverse.docx' was normalized to basename and served, so no traversal proven. This is a candidate stored XSS/unrestricted upload, pending independent validator.

ee93c5.title: Upload XSS deduplicated to vuln-0005
ee93c5.content: Root agent confirms sibling SVG/upload validation chain filed the same upload root cause as vuln-0005. This agent's arbitrary-extension and inline serving evidence is supporting detail only; no duplicate report filed. Traversal filename tests normalized to basename; no path escape demonstrated.

1fc657.title: Authenticated editor role validation
1fc657.content: Using the provided test account in an isolated session, login succeeded and `/redaksi/profile/` identified the account as `Editor` (display name redacted in this note). Profile form exposes `status_role` options only `Wartawan` and `Editor`; no `Admin` option is rendered. Anonymous/session cookie included only normal Django `sessionid` + `csrftoken`. Read-only GET `/admin/alfikr/` with the authenticated Editor reached Django admin code but returned a DEBUG 500 (`AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'all'` in Django auth backend), not an admin interface or user-management page. GET `/admin/alfikr/auth/user/` and `/admin/alfikr/auth/user/add/` returned 404. No mutation or role change was attempted. Server-side acceptance of forged `status_role=Admin` remains unverified because testing it would alter production state.

11527b.title: Role enumeration follow-up
11527b.content: Fresh cache-busted sessions repeatedly returned `/redaksi/profile/` with author-box job `Redaksi`; raw HTML role selector contains only `Wartawan` and `Editor` and no selected attribute. Browser DOM in one session displayed `Editor`, while fresh navigation displayed `Redaksi`, indicating inconsistent display/template state. Route variants `/data/berita/Editor/`, `/Wartawan/`, `/Admin/`, `/Redaksi/` all returned the same dashboard HTML; this did not establish additional roles or authorization. No mutation attempted.
